We don’t have to wait for perfect conditions or guaranteed safety. We were born with wings —the strength, the faith, the courage inside us.

Video

Trump's immigration enforcement continues its cruelty and lack of human decency.

Video

We can choose leaders who lead with truth, humility, and a deep belief in the dignity of every American. Leaders who bring us together instead of tearing us apart.

Video

We cannot ignore the dangers of the Warner Bros.-Paramount merger. It threatens free speech, drives up costs, and limits access to independent news and diverse storytelling. 

Corporate consolidation like this strikes at the heart of our democracy and the creative expression that connects us as a people. 

The merger is far from a done deal, and I will continue to fight it.

Video

The reality of Trump’s budget bill is hitting hard: billions cut from Medicaid, families losing vital health coverage, and hunger growing across the country.

This is not the America we stand for. We deserve better.

Video

The Trump administration continues to show the depth of their corruption, lack of transparency and how they are grifting off of the office.

Video

Do the work.
Choose the attitude.

You may have to go through it - 
but you can glow through it.

Here’s to the people who light it up…
and ignite something in the rest of us too.

These are challenging times - 
but real leaders remind us:

We don't have to shrink in hard times…
we can shine through them.

Video

Never confuse

worth with wealth,
significance with celebrity,
or connection with attention.

Don’t chase “look at me.”
Choose “how are you?”

Video

Congresswoman Jayapal laying it plain.

Video

This is yet another deeply insulting daily moment from Donald Trump.

Leadership isn’t about lifting yourself up by tearing others down.
It’s about lifting others - period.

Leadership shines light. It doesn’t cast shadows.
It leads with integrity.
It does not lead with lies.

Video

Trump’s reckless war in Iran has no justification,no authorization and no exit strategy.
Now Americans are facing skyrocketing costs and oil shocks, while hundreds of our brave service members have been injured and 13 have been tragically killed. 

I won't stop standing up on the Senate floor to stop this war.

Video

Trump's cruel immigration policies are hurting us all.

Video

Trump's reckless tariffs — slapped on without Congress’s approval, burdening working families with higher prices on food, clothes, and essentials — have now been struck down.  Now The administration is being forced to issue massive refunds to importers.

These unconstitutional tariffs never should have been imposed in the first place.

Video

Trump has been Humiliated on the Global Stage

He promised unconditional surrender — he got none. 
He wanted regime change — we now have a more extreme regime. 
He claimed he’d end Iran’s nuclear path — they still have highly enriched material. 
He said he’d stop civilian deaths — yet so many innocents have died from these bombs.

Video

Watch this beautiful moment and remember what truly binds us: unconditional love. A child’s hug reminding Mom she’s not alone—that pure, healing embrace. This is the grace we all need more of.

Video

I love this. What a gift. There is such power in feeling seen, connected, acknowledged. We need more of that, not just from the famous but from all of us.

Video

This is heartbreaking and unconscionable. After weeks in family detention, toddler Amalia was rushed to a hospital with critically low oxygen levels. She fought for her life in intensive care—under ICE watch—only to be sent back to the very Dilley center where she nearly died, amid widespread respiratory illnesses among children.

This cruelty has no place in America.

Video

Farmers and truckers are being pushed to the brink - skyrocketing diesel costs, endless economic ripples from this unjust war.

Video

Our brave service members are doing their jobs, and facing life and death situations every day. Congressional Republicans should be doing their job, fulfilling their constitutional responsibility and checking this out of control president. 

I will continue to fight with every tool and power we have in the Senate to stop this reckless war

Video

The DOJ indicted the Southern Poverty Law Center, an organization that has spent more than half a century fighting the Klan, tracking hate, and defending civil rights.

Let's be clear about what's happening. This administration is using the full weight of federal prosecution to target an organization whose mission is rooting out violent extremism.
